name: Okta - Alert on User Account Lockouts
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = okta_sso_raw
| filter xdm.event.operation in ("user.account.lock", "user.account.lock.limit")
| fields xdm.source.user.upn as user, xdm.event.operation as lock_op, _time as lockTime
| join type = inner (
    datamodel dataset = okta_sso_raw
    | filter xdm.event.outcome = "FAILED"
        and (xdm.event.operation = "user.session.start"
             or xdm.event.operation contains "user.authentication.")
    | fields xdm.source.user.upn as failUser, xdm.source.ipv4 as failIP, _time as failTime) as f
  f.failUser = user
| filter failTime <= lockTime and timestamp_diff(lockTime, failTime, "MINUTE") <= 30
| comp count() as failures, values(failIP) as fail_ips by user, lock_op, lockTime
| filter failures >= 5
description: An Okta account was locked out after 5 or more failed sign-ins for the same user in the preceding 30 minutes: a brute-force or password-guessing attempt against that account. Unlock events are not matched. One issue per user.
alert_name: Okta - Alert on User Account Lockouts
alert_description: Okta locked this account after repeated failed sign-ins. Check the failure count and source IPs for brute force or password spraying.
